verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into NetHunt CRM that users can hand tasks to. The MCP claim (docs-1) describes connecting external assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude, which is a different capability and earns no credit here. The automations are trigger-based workflows, and the call summary is not described as an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
